description_en: Imports a table to a workflow. The call to this API operation is equivalent to performing the following operations: Go to the DataStudio page, find the desired workflow, and then click the workflow name. Right-click Table under the desired folder and select Import Table
description_zh: 相当于在数据开发页面右键单击业务流程，选择导入表的操作
name: EstablishRelationTableToBusiness

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the Workspace Manage icon in the upper-right corner of the DataStudio page to go to the Workspace Management page and view the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the identifier in the upper-left corner of the DataStudio page to switch to another workspace.

You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程的ID，您可以使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html获取对应业务流程的ID
parameters.name: business_id

parameters.help_en: The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173919.html operation to query the UUID
parameters.help_zh: 表的UUID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173919.html获取对应表的UUID
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the folder. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173952.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173955.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件夹的ID，您可以使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173952.html或者https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173955.html获取对应文件夹的ID
parameters.name: folder_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
